scope_note: Morocco confirmed Yango market. Agadir-Essaouira is already deep; this pass tops up the three thin cities -- Tangier, Rabat-Sale, Al-Hoceima -- with real sourced marinas and short-hop corridors on each coast. Morocco has TWO coasts (Mediterranean strait coast + Atlantic coast) that never chain into one national corridor.
no_invention_rule: Every BP is a real named marina/port with a source URL. Grok does deterministic ID-match, coords, and seal.
hazards_global: Strait of Gibraltar shipping lanes + the Spanish enclaves of Ceuta and Melilla. All corridors must stay in Moroccan waters and route offshore of Ceuta/Melilla headlands; Grok's land/border mask must treat the enclaves as no-go.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Tanja Marina Bay (Basin 1)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Morocco's first urban marina in the heart of Tangier; 1,400-berth capacity across two basins, Blue-Flag.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Tanja Marina Bay (Basin 2 / superyacht)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Second basin of the urban marina.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Malabata waterfront
boarding_point_candidates.note: Beach-resort waterfront east of the marina toward Cap Malabata.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Round Cap Malabata then run E along the Med coast; offshore waypoint to stay SOUTH of the Ceuta (Spanish) headland -- never route through Ceuta waters.

new_city.name: M'diq / Tetouan
new_city.note: Marina Smir + Kabila + M'diq: the Tetouan-region Mediterranean resort marinas.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Marina Smir
boarding_point_candidates.note: Full marina at M'diq near Tetouan on the Mediterranean coast.

boarding_point_candidates.name: M'diq / Kabila waterfront
boarding_point_candidates.note: Resort marina/port just north of Marina Smir.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Al-Hoceima port
boarding_point_candidates.note: Bay port of Al-Hoceima; existing anchor.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Short coastal hop north; offshore of the M'diq breakwater.
Coastal run west within the Bay of Al-Hoceima; offshore of the Penon de Velez (Spanish islet) -- stay in Moroccan water.

mediterranean_coast.range_note: M'diq/Tetouan cluster and Al-Hoceima cluster are ~70 nm apart -- range-edge; keep as two local clusters, not one continuous corridor.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Marina Bouregreg (Rabat bank)
boarding_point_candidates.note: At the mouth of the Bouregreg River, sheltered from Atlantic swell, on the Rabat side.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Marina Bouregreg (Sale bank)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Sale riverfront side of the same marina, opposite Rabat's historic skyline.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Mohammedia marina
boarding_point_candidates.note: Atlantic marina between Rabat and Casablanca.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Cross the Bouregreg river mouth between the twin banks; stay inside the breakwater training walls.
Open Atlantic coastal run SW; offshore waypoints clear of the surf line. Atlantic swell exposure -- Grok verify sea-state assumptions.
Short Atlantic coastal hop into the Port of Casablanca; offshore of the Mohammedia refinery jetties.
